svg.title: Dossiya Dakou — mathematical engineering research portrait
svg.desc: Animated mathematical-art research portrait separating physical Power and Transportation topology, causal interfaces, and schematic state-space viability geometry. Vector field, level sets and motion are explanatory visual mathematics, not measured infrastructure telemetry.
svg.text: Physical reality → causal mechanism → mathematical structure → engineering decision
schematic phase portrait · level sets · admissible boundary · resilience margin
vector field + level sets are deterministic visual mathematics, not fitted data
current research transition · Causal Mechanisms → Coupled Hybrid Multiscale Dynamics
Visual grammar: ink = physical system · gold = causal/decision structure · blue = mathematical state/dynamics. Motion is not a measured flow or empirical validation.
